band.$description: The full-bleed brand band: the site's footer, the /contact page and the /works header. It replaced a fixed gradient JPEG that ignored all four axes. Two colour stops and one label — and because a theme may point both stops at the same semantic, a flat band falls out of the same two lines of CSS as a gradient one. That is how `brutalist` and `terminal` opt out of the gradient, and how every high-contrast block flattens it.
